audit.recompute_scope: the eligibility counts and seed ids come from the eligibility pass, not from the raw rows; the oracle arm's per-row bits are recomputed from the retained per-row operating-fraction degree-2 residuals; the heuristic arm's per-row bits are recomputed from the retained per-row full degree-2 residual profiles (the degree-2 observed commutation residual at all 8 grid points, 8 floats per candidate) — BOTH non-learned arms recompute from the raw rows alone; the learned arm's per-row bits are recomputable only with the retained model (hash-pinned in training.model_state_sha256); this block recomputes the aggregation from the retained raw rows

claims.description: the learned router beats the polluted argmin observed-residual oracle (operating-fraction degree-2 column) at the held-out fraction 0.7
claims.estimand: mean over eligible seeds of d_oracle(seed, 0.7) with d_oracle = learned_acc - oracle_acc, accuracies over R=4 shared replicate draws

claims.description: the learned router beats the polluted argmin observed-residual oracle (operating-fraction degree-2 column) at the held-out fraction 0.6
claims.estimand: mean over eligible seeds of d_oracle(seed, 0.6) with d_oracle = learned_acc - oracle_acc, accuracies over R=4 shared replicate draws

claims.description: the learned router beats the polluted argmin observed-residual oracle (operating-fraction degree-2 column) at the held-out fraction 0.8
claims.estimand: mean over eligible seeds of d_oracle(seed, 0.8) with d_oracle = learned_acc - oracle_acc, accuracies over R=4 shared replicate draws

claims.description: the learned router beats the non-learned grid-mean log1p degree-2 profile heuristic at the held-out fraction 0.7
claims.estimand: mean over eligible seeds of d_heur(seed, 0.7) with d_heur = learned_acc - heuristic_acc, accuracies over R=4 shared replicate draws

claims.method: one-sided Student-t lower bounds with Bonferroni correction; the generator seed is the inference unit

baselines.heuristic: descriptive non-learned heuristic: argmin of the grid-mean log1p degree-2 profile (the profile-shape comparator of H4)
baselines.oracle: polluted argmin observed-residual oracle: argmin of the operating-fraction degree-2 residual column (polluted at every fraction — no clean column exists)

design.declared_caveat: the comparison is asymmetric by design: the learned router integrates the full degree-2 degraded profile; the oracle reads only one polluted column (the operating fraction's degree-2 residual). The heuristic baseline in H4 is the profile-shape non-learned comparator. Demo-scale numbers are not evidence.
design.eligibility_rule: the instance builds and the clean audit on the UNDEGRADED instance passes at degree 2 (true misfit <= 1e-9, every decoy > 1e-9); deterministic per seed and never entering features
design.estimand: per (seed, fraction) accuracies over R=4 shared replicates; paired differences d_oracle = learned_acc - oracle_acc and d_heur = learned_acc - heuristic_acc
design.feature: the 18-dim degree-2 no-anchor degradation-profile feature vector exactly as this runner's group_candidate_features computes it: log1p of the degree-2 observed nerve commutation residual at the 8 grid points under the row's observation draw (8 columns), the 7 first-difference slopes, and 3 structural dims (target group order, morphism count N1, composable-pair count N2) read off the observed nerve
design.observation_degradation: universa.partial_group.GroupObservationModel with corrupt_fraction = g at every grid point (a nested prefix of one master permutation of the n^2 table entries has its observed product replaced by a different uniformly-drawn element); the profile grid 0.2..0.9 by 0.1 excludes 0.0 — no clean column exists anywhere (the no-anchor regime, lifted to group nerves)
design.permutation: per (seed, fraction) from subseed(seed, 'router-v2-permutation', f'{fraction:.6f}'), shared across the row's replicates, with audited labels
design.raw_row_retention: each eval raw row retains, per candidate, the full degree-2 residual profile (the degree-2 observed commutation residual at all 8 grid points; 8 raw floats, permuted candidate order) plus the operating-fraction degree-2 residual, so the oracle AND heuristic arms' per-row bits are recomputable from the raw rows alone (the audit block recomputes them); only the learned arm needs the retained hash-pinned model
design.replicate_subseed: subseed(seed, 'sealed-replicate', str(fraction), str(replicate_index)) per data row, driving the nested corruption draw (group-observe, corrupt); the same observation_seed feeds all arms within a row (paired)
design.task_family: group-nerve switch instances via universa.category_instances.make_group_switch_instance(family='z6_to_z3', num_decoys=2) (Z/6 -> Z/3 by reduction mod 3 through the bar construction); K=3 candidates, true target at index 0 pre-permutation
design.train_replicates: one replicate (index 0) per train (seed, fraction); 800 rows

training.standardization: input mean/std measured on the train block only
training.validation_monitor: the train block itself; the frozen design defines no validation split
